tools.name: list_metros
tools.description: The metropolitan areas with published rankings, and which service categories each one covers. Call this first to learn the slugs the other tools expect.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every service category the site ranks, with a note on what Texas does and does not license for that trade.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.description: The ranked list of independent companies for one category in one metropolitan area, with scores, verification status, and the reasons any tracked company is unranked. Franchise and chain locations are excluded by editorial policy.

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Everything published about one company: score breakdown by pillar, what was verified and with which authority, what could not be verified, review figures with the date they were read, and every ranking it appears in.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find tracked companies by name, metropolitan area, category, or minimum score.

tools.name: compare_businesses
tools.description: Compare two to four companies side by side, pillar by pillar, with a one-sentence verdict naming which pillar separates them.

tools.name: get_score_breakdown
tools.description: Return one company's score in one metro/category ranking, including rank, all five weighted pillars, each pillar's point contribution, and provenance.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: The exact weights, thresholds, eligibility rules, data sources, and stated limitations behind every score. Read this before characterising what a TRP Score means.
